summary: The human revision comment requires removing the raw MongoDB ObjectId 'ID' column from the item listing table in the frontend page. This plan modifies the existing app/item-listing-crud/page.tsx file to exclude the ID column from the displayed table while maintaining all other functionality and data mappings. No other files need modification as the backend and API structure already correctly handles the MongoDB _id field without exposing it to users.

files.rationale: Remove the raw MongoDB ObjectId 'ID' column from the item listing table as per the human revision comment. The table should only display user-facing fields (name, price, quantity, category) without exposing the internal database ID.
